about: Firmware (lib/engine/firmware.ts): with firmware loaded, its attack takes Strike's place, and the firmware grows over many hosts. Every room fight won with it loaded gives it xp (an elite more, a boss or the chapter's set piece most); its level never resets on death. Each firmware's attack starts from `base` and its damage is `scale` times the wearer's physical attack; every level from 2 adds what it lists (scale and heat add up, the rest replace). `xpToNext[n]` is the xp from level n+1 to n+2.

base.name: Hydraulic Slam
base.description: Volkov operator firmware: the whole frame behind one blow. Reaches two tiles in a line.
